source_evidence: Call risk refers to the potential for an issuer to repay a bond before its maturity date, something that an issuer may do if interest rates decline
answer: Call risk is the possibility that a municipal bond issuer will repay the bond early, before its stated maturity date. An issuer may be more likely to do this when interest rates decline. Because many municipal bonds are callable, check a bond’s call provisions if you are considering holding it until maturity.
